summary: Inspected the retained 1920 px reference, rendered and diff crops for account-registration-dialog and verified its assigned comparison geometry and pixel diagnostics. The outer dialog geometry is exact at 802x752 px with zero delta and its crop mismatch is 6.040%, but visible controls and typography alignment remain materially different.
issues: CHK-REG-001 | priority: high | property: dialog close control | expected: visible X control near the upper-right corner at about x 666, y 48 within the crop | actual: no close control is visible in the rendered crop | fix: render the source-backed close icon/control at the captured position and size with accessible dialog-close semantics.

CHK-REG-002 | priority: medium | property: input placeholder alignment | expected: placeholders left-aligned with about 15 px inner inset | actual: placeholders are horizontally centered | fix: restore source text alignment and left padding without changing the already-exact field bounds.

CHK-REG-003 | priority: high | property: registration CTA geometry and vertical spacing | expected: pill-shaped 223x44 px CTA starting near x 43, y 658 with about 36 px separation below the consent row | actual: rectangular 223x44 px CTA starts near y 614, about 44 px too high and only about 6 px below the consent line | fix: restore the source vertical gap and pill border radius while retaining exact dialog geometry.
